tagline.en: DROID-W — a robot world model that generates video to evaluate and roll out policies in the DROID setting.
tagline.zh: DROID-W——面向 DROID 场景的机器人世界模型,通过生成视频来评估与推演策略。

en: DROID-W is a robot world model. Rather than directly controlling a robot, a world model learns to predict how a scene evolves, which lets you imagine and evaluate what a policy would do before running it on hardware. DROID-W is aimed at the DROID robot-manipulation setting and generates video as part of that.

In WorldFoundry the DROID-W source route is registered so you can resolve its configuration and import its pipeline. Running real generation or evaluation additionally requires the DROID-W checkpoints and datasets, which are fetched separately.
Once those assets are in place, you use DROID-W through WorldFoundry's shared pipeline for robot-world-model, video-generation, and DROID-evaluation tasks.
zh: DROID-W 是一个机器人世界模型。世界模型并不直接控制机器人,而是学习预测场景如何演变,从而让你在真机运行之前,先想象并评估某个策略会做什么。DROID-W 面向 DROID 机器人操作场景,并在此过程中生成视频。
在 WorldFoundry 中,DROID-W 的源码路由已注册,你可以解析其配置并导入其 pipeline。要运行真正的生成或评估,还需要 DROID-W 的 checkpoint 与数据集,这些需单独获取。
当这些资产就位后,你可通过 WorldFoundry 的统一 pipeline,将 DROID-W 用于机器人世界模型、视频生成与 DROID 评估等任务。

whenToUse.en: Use DROID-W when you want a world model to predict video and evaluate robot policies in the DROID manipulation setting.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想用一个世界模型在 DROID 操作场景中预测视频、评估机器人策略时,可以选择 DROID-W。

notFor.en: It isn't a direct action policy, and it can't generate until its checkpoints and datasets are downloaded and staged. Budget for those assets before you plan a run.
notFor.zh: 它不是直接的动作策略,在其 checkpoint 与数据集下载并准备好之前也无法生成。规划运行前请为这些资产预留资源。
